profile.headline: software engineer  at Google
profile.summary:
Profit by making beautiful things that people love!
Solve complex business and user problems through technology


Seasoned leader with 2 years of industry experience working in large cross boundary, cross functional ventures with internationally placed teams.

1 yrs as a program manager/product manager
1 yrs as a Microsoft program manager (1yrs in Windows, 1yr in Windows Live Id)

Computer engineering graduate

Specialties: Product management - search, analyze, and propose the next product step. Define and specify feature set, and success criterion. Own and take all product decisions across the product cycle.

Program management - bring product decisions and dreams to life by leading globally located cross-functional teams

People management - awesome teams produce awesome products. Keeping people motivated to perform their best. Performance, and Compensation management.

positions.title: Senior Program Manager (Windows 8)
positions.description:
Worked on
(i) the Modern Reader app for PDF/XPS/OXPS files
(ii) Modern Music and Video apps

I was the owner of
- PDF graphics, rendering, and printing, XPS support, and Reader app performance (files open fast, and panning is butter smooth)
- Snap view of the Modern Music and Video apps

Stuff I'm proud of -
- Patent received for “UI of the Snap view of Media applications”
- Microsoft IDC Innovation award finalist 2012 for Perf-o-meter - Performance Analyzer and bugger for PDF and XPS
- Microsoft IDC Innovation award finalist 2011 for PDFStop - PDF planning and rendering verification tools
- Star awards for (i) PDFStop toolset – a cross functional multi-disciplinary tool for analyzing PDFs, (ii) Selfhost champion in Windows
- Rave reviews on perf of the beta release of Reader - “Large files open quickly and scrolling through documents is equally fast…. This is far more pleasant to use than Acrobat Reader (and noticeably faster)” (Source: http://reviewtechnew.com/hands-on-windows-8-review/

positions.title: software developer
positions.description:
What I do is the same thing that any other engineer does......
''I solve problems for my client, and ensure that my solution meets all of the constraints in which the client requires the solution to operate.''

positions.title: Program Manager II (Windows Live ID)
positions.description:
Windows Live ID (aka Microsoft Passport) is a single sign-on authentication service for all Windows Live properties.


Passport Support Tool (PST) is a web based tool used by Customer Support Reps (CSRs) to resolve any issue

Contribution
- Program management for Passport Support: added support for Windows Live 5.0 features (linked ids, federated accounts) in PST.
- Reduced customer support operational cost by 3%, and planned for a total of 7% in the coming year. Increased Customer Satisfaction by 5% with projected increase of a total of 8% in the coming year.
- Live site support – released 2 QoS (patch) releases. Ensured 100% uptime for PST.
- UX point of contact for Windows Live: I worked with several teams under our organization’s umbrella to improve their web design and user flows that led to direct measurable profits.
- Mentor for one Program Manager, who was new to the role.
